We're looking for a Principal Systems Designer to join us on an exciting unannounced title built on a globally recognized IP. This is an F2P, mobile-first live-service game currently in pre-production, and our team is defining the systems and progression that will support the game over the long term.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day, whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the gaming industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You'll own the design and implementation of core systems, working with the Director of Systems Design and the broader systems and gameplay teams to turn ambiguous, zero-to-one problems into shippable, well-instrumented systems. You'll work across quantitative modeling and in-engine implementation, building the tuning, tools, and systems needed to bring progression models to life. You'll also partner closely with combat and gameplay design to ensure abilities, progression, and scaling work together as a cohesive player experience.

What You'll Do

• Design and build core systems, including progression, combat scaling, economy, and rewards, from initial definition through shippable implementation
• Partner with gameplay designers to ensure combat abilities, RPG progression, and scaling reinforce one another across the live-service lifecycle
• Build and maintain models, simulations, and tuning tools that define loot tables, costs, XP curves, and stat scaling as the game evolves
• Implement, tune, and iterate on systems directly in Unity and supporting design tools
• Create clear design documentation that enables designers, engineers, and producers to execute effectively
• Collaborate with engineering to define tools and pipelines that enable efficient systems authoring, tuning, and balancing
• Use playtest results and analytics to evaluate system performance, identify opportunities, and iterate based on evidence
• Evaluate system proposals constructively, identifying design risks, tradeoffs, and opportunities for improvement while supporting systems that can evolve with future content

What You'll Bring

• Ideally 8+ years of experience owning complex progression, economy, combat-adjacent, or related systems through development and launch or live operations
• Strong technical capability, including experience building/maintaining spreadsheets and implementing systems in Unity, Unreal, a proprietary engine, or a scripting/tools environment
• Deep understanding of RPG progression and scaling, including power curves, stat growth, gear or ability scaling, and their relationship with combat and content difficulty
• Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including sound judgment about the strengths and limitations of data
• Experience taking systems from initial definition through implementation, tuning, and a shippable state
• Ability to translate ambiguous design problems into clear documentation that engineering, production, and other design partners can act on
• Experience collaborating with combat, gameplay, or content designers to align progression systems with moment-to-moment gameplay
• Evidence of learning from feedback, collaborating constructively across disciplines, and staying closely involved in implementation and iteration

Bonus Points

• Experience designing systems for F2P collector games
• Experience with multiplayer action RPGs
• Experience working with licensed IP

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About The Role

Help bring Cohere's enablement strategy to life for our field teams in North America. This generalist role will build and manage programs end-to-end, from design through rollout, measurement, and iteration, while working directly with managers and reps to ensure enablement drives results. You'll report to the Head of Sales Enablement and help establish operational rigor as this global function scales.

Key Responsibilities

- Own enablement programs from design through rollout, measurement, and iteration

- Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales Leadership, and RevOps to align GTM priorities and embed enablement into every stage of the sales lifecycle

- Create and curate high-impact resources (playbooks, battle cards, demo scripts, certification programs) for Cohere's solutions

- Establish KPIs (win rates, sales cycle efficiency) and use analytics to refine initiatives and prove ROI

- Operationalize MEDDPICC methodology into everyday seller behavior (deal reviews, coaching, planning)

- Build certification paths that accelerate new seller productivity across regions and cultures

- Maintain and evolve the enablement content platform to ensure global adoption

- Identify automation opportunities for repeatable work, and develop practical AI workflows that improve team output

- Work directly with field leadership on joint calls, deal coaching, and in-market visits

- Translate field insights into updated content, playbooks, and qualification guides

- Keep sellers current on product lineup, competitive positioning, and use-case narratives

- Balance live training, program management, and strategic planning across time zones

- Measure program impact (ramp time, win rates, pipeline generation, deal velocity) and report to leadership

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years in sales enablement, sales training, revenue operations, or related GTM role (B2B SaaS/tech preferred)

- Experience supporting multi-region sales organizations with cultural/time zone awareness

- Proven ability to design and ship programs from scratch

- AI-fluent with track record of scaling enablement using AI tools

- Field-oriented approach—you thrive on direct deal reviews and coaching

- Mastery of enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).

- Clear communication across all levels (reps to leadership)

- Comfort with ambiguity and building in fast-paced environments

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

NICE TO HAVE

- Technical fluency in AI/ML concepts (RAG, model selection, competitive differentiation)

- Enterprise software sales experience

- Sales enablement/instructional design certification

- Hyper-growth enablement scaling experience

- Additional regional languages

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

A Brief Overview

Reporting to the Regional Head of Underwriting, Claims & Biometric Risk, EMEA, the Head of Underwriting & Claims Enterprise Transformation is responsible for shaping and leading the regional transformation agenda for underwriting, claims, medical and biometric capabilities. The role is expected to challenge current ways of working, reimagine how underwriting and claims could be delivered in the future, and lead innovation that creates more scalable, data-led and client-focused solutions across EMEA. This includes identifying, developing and embedding solutions that improve client value, operational efficiency, risk assessment and market competitiveness. Working through a regional and enterprise matrix, the role partners with market leaders, Strategic Execution, technology, data, medical, underwriting and claims teams to prioritise opportunities and align delivery with regional and enterprise objectives. While initiatives may originate within individual markets or sub-regions, the role is accountable for shaping solutions that provide broader regional benefit and supporting their implementation and adoption across relevant markets. The role also identifies and leverages best practices, capabilities and solutions from across the wider RGA Group, adapting them where appropriate to support EMEA priorities. It shapes the transformation agenda while enabling delivery through enterprise and sub-regional teams, rather than directly owning all technology execution.

What you will do

• Develop and lead the EMEA underwriting, claims, medical and biometric transformation strategy, aligned to business and enterprise priorities.
• Lead the digitalisation of underwriting and claims capabilities across EMEA, developing scalable solutions that improve customer experience, risk assessment, decision-making and operational efficiency. Partner with sub-regions to support adoption and delivery across multiple markets and business segments.
• Leveraging technology, advanced analytics, emerging data sources, predictive modelling and strategic partnerships to identify new opportunities, enhance underwriting practices and pioneer innovative reinsurance solutions.
• Lead scalable biometric solutions that strengthen underwriting and claims capabilities across EMEA. Partner with medical, underwriting and claims experts as well as actuaries and data scientists to translate emerging biometric insights into practical client solutions and promote consistent best practice across sub-regions.
• Drive transformation and continuous improvement across people, processes and systems, in alignment with global and regional stakeholders. Leverage AI, data and technology to enable end-to-end processes to improve productivity and deliver efficiency gains.
• Partner with Strategic Execution, enterprise technology, business leaders, vendors and industry players to deliver transformation objectives, identify opportunities and accelerate innovation adoption across markets.
• Collaborate with the regional Underwriting, Claims, Medical & Biometric Risk leadership team and SME’s, to deliver the EMEA strategy and share best practices across markets.
• Represent RGA externally on underwriting and claims innovation, digital transformation and emerging technologies. Share insights with clients and industry stakeholders and support business development through innovative client propositions and value-added solutions.
• Build and lead a high-performing transformation and innovation function, developing regional capability in digital underwriting and claims, automation, analytics and innovation. Foster creativity, continuous improvement and talent development through coaching and mentoring.

Qualifications

• Relevant qualification in insurance, risk, underwriting, claims, technology, business transformation or a related discipline required
• Significant experience within life and health insurance, reinsurance, underwriting, claims or related risk disciplines required
• Proven experience leading large-scale transformation, innovation or digital strategy programmes and delivering technology-enabled business change required
• Experience managing complex stakeholder environments across multiple markets or jurisdictions and influencing senior leadership teams required
• Strong understanding of underwriting and/or claims processes and emerging industry trends required
• Experience leading AI, automation, data analytics or digital underwriting initiatives preferred
• Experience working within a global or regional matrix organisation preferred
• Strategic thinking and innovation mindset required
• Leadership and stakeholder management required
• Translate emerging technologies into practical business solutions required
• Commercial awareness and client focus required
• Communication and presentation skills required
• Programme and change management expertise required
• Analytical, creative and solution-oriented problem solving required
• Balance innovation with governance, risk management and operational practicality required
• Project, programme or change management certification preferred

What you can expect from RGA:

•

Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

•

Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

•

Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. 자격 요건

ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Mistral AI’s Defense team to build software for defense institutions and industry.

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with strong engineering fundamentals and a background in data engineering or transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You will help shape the architecture, write production code and own substantial software components, from design through deployment and operation.

This role offers the scope and autonomy of a senior technical individual contributor in a small team. It is particularly suited to engineers operating at Senior or Staff level in demanding product engineering environments who want broad ownership and to stay deeply involved in implementation.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design and build services for data ingestion, transformation, storage, querying and operational workflows.

- Develop shared data models, APIs and SDKs that help engineers build applications on a consistent foundation.

- Make authorization a core part of the architecture: define and enforce which users, applications and agents can access data or perform actions, with clear audit trails.

- Solve problems involving data consistency, schema evolution, concurrency, performance and failure recovery across services and data systems.

- Turn needs from our applied engineers and defense users into reusable software capabilities, making pragmatic choices about what to build and how to evolve them.

- Own delivery end to end, including implementation, testing, observability, debugging and maintainability in demanding deployment environments.

- Use AI coding tools and coding agents extensively to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring and debugging. Help the team improve these workflows while maintaining a high engineering standard.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong practical familiarity with AI coding tools and agentic engineering workflows. You use coding agents regularly, can break complex work into well-scoped tasks, provide effective context, review generated code and validate the result through tests and debugging. You remain accountable for the architecture, correctness, security and maintainability of what you ship.

- A strong track record of building and operating production software, with substantial ownership of complex systems.

- Experience in data engineering or in building transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You understand the trade-offs behind data models, storage, query execution and service boundaries.

- Experience building products where access control, permissions and data governance are central to how the system works. Work on platforms such as Foundry, or systems with comparable requirements, is particularly relevant.

- Broad software engineering skills and the ability to move between architecture, implementation and production debugging. You are comfortable working across unfamiliar parts of a codebase.

- Strong proficiency in Python or another programming language, solid SQL skills and the ability to become productive quickly in a Python and TypeScript environment.

- High autonomy and sound judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a concrete plan, make technical decisions and deliver useful increments with limited supervision.

- A collaborative approach to technical leadership through code, design discussions, reviews and mentoring, and a clear motivation to build software for defense institutions and industry.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience building a data platform or developer product used by other engineering teams.

- Experience with fine-grained authorization, multi-tenant architectures, data lineage or auditable operational workflows.

- Experience with self-hosted software, restricted networks or other demanding deployment constraints.

- Familiarity with LLM applications and their integration with data and tools.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.

PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. We are looking for a dynamic, organised self-starter to join as a Senior Program Manager to grow the Amazon Global Store business in Australia, based from our Sydney office.

Amazon Global Store is in integral pillar of the Amazon.com.au proposition that today offers high demand international products, locally to AU customers. We are an innovative business focused on building a leading customer experience around our growing range of relevant international products sourced from Amazon’s global stores. We work with Amazon’s wider global business network, across teams such as search, customer experience, vendor management, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, legal and compliance to tailor the best that Amazon has to offer globally into a proposition that best suits local customers’ needs.
________________________________________________

There are also a great range of benefits that make Amazon a great place to work, including our popular Dogs At Work program which has been proven to lower stress and boost morale and is now running successfully in our corporate offices around Australia.

Our commuter benefits scheme allows employees to save on the cost of getting to and from work while Amazon also offers subsidized health insurance for employees and their dependents on top of salary continuance (income protection), and life insurance.

Amazon has all kinds of jobs for all kinds of people, and prides itself on hiring individuals with all types of background and experiences and celebrates diversity of leadership and thought as a key component in its mission to create the most customer-centric company in the world.

This position requires full-time in-office presence 5 days per week at our CBD location.

Key job responsibilities
To excel in this role, you will:
- Enjoy a high degree of ownership: Own the Global Store strategy end to end, from defining selection, pricing, promotions, and marketing, to driving execution plans with local and global teams that deliver adoption and sustainable growth.
- Excel at stakeholder management: Drive outcomes through others by building strong relationships and influencing cross-functional teams, including search, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, and compliance, across multiple geographies. Navigate ambiguity and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals without direct authority.
- Drive commercial performance through data: Go beyond reviewing dashboards. Proactively dive deep into metrics, uncover opportunities, build business cases, and develop actionable recommendations that improve growth, profitability, and customer value.
- Customer Experience Ownership: Think big and invent new ways to improve Global Store CX, locally and internationally.
- Technology and AI Adoption: Embrace AI and new technologies, diving into Amazon's tools and systems quickly and confidently to find faster, smarter ways to operate.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment: Demonstrate strong organisational skills and effectively prioritise competing demands across multiple workstreams, making sound judgment calls independently when priorities conflict.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on growing the AU Global Store business by working across multiple teams and geographies. You might start your day analysing customer data to identify opportunities for improving the shopping experience, then move into strategy sessions with local and international teams to plan how to expand our product offerings. You'll collaborate with colleagues in search, customer experience, vendor management, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, legal, and compliance to bring the best of Amazon's global selection to Australian customers. Throughout the day, you'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving, whether that's developing execution plans, troubleshooting challenges, or presenting business results to senior leadership.

We are building an innovative business that serves as a key pillar of Amazon.com.au, bringing international products to customers who want access to a broader selection. Our team works collaboratively across Amazon's global network to understand what Australian customers need and translate that into tailored solutions. We're focused on creating a leading customer experience while driving sustainable business growth. When you join us, you'll be part of a group that values curiosity, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to solve complex problems together.

Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations. What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked! • Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road • Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL. • Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon. • Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.
